annotations.title: Meta ad account settings: spend cap and EU DSA defaults

description: A Meta ad account's own settings. action get (default): name, status, currency, the account SPEND CAP and how much is spent against it, the default EU DSA beneficiary and payor, and Meta's suggested names for those two fields. action update: name; spendCap (the total the account may spend, in the account currency, e.g. 500 for 500.00; null removes the cap); resetAmountSpent:true (sets the amount spent against the cap back to 0); dsaBeneficiary + dsaPayor (the defaults every EU-targeted ad set inherits; send both, two empty strings clear them). Raising or removing the cap and resetting the amount spent let the account spend more, so they need confirm:true after the user agrees; lowering a cap, renaming and DSA defaults do not. When a cap is reached Meta pauses every campaign on the account. Read back from Meta. Free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_123 or the bare number); it must be one this brand has shared

confirm.description: true after the user agreed to raise or remove the cap or reset the amount spent

dsaBeneficiary.description: update: default EU DSA beneficiary (send with dsaPayor; "" clears)

dsaPayor.description: update: default EU DSA payor (send with dsaBeneficiary; "" clears)

resetAmountSpent.description: update: true sets the amount spent against the cap back to 0

spendCap.description: update: the account spend cap in the account currency; null removes it
